phase3.gigsHelp.en: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.gigsHelp.draft: Ayyukan gida na ɗan gajeren lokaci, bincika sharuddan saki tare da jami'in ku.

phase3.housingHelp.en: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.housingHelp.draft: Manufofin tanadi da shirin shirye-shiryen gidaje. Groundwork ba ta samar da gidaje kuma ba ta haɗin gwiwa tare da masu samarwa. Don taimakon gida, kira 211.

phase3.paidNote.en: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.
phase3.paidNote.draft: Ba a kafa farashi ba tukuna.

phase3.tokensHelp.draft: Lambobin ba su da darajar kuɗi.

reentry.crisisStep.en: Save these numbers now. You can also tap Need help now at the top of any screen.
reentry.crisisStep.draft: Za ka kuma iya matsa Bukatar taimako yanzu a saman kowane allon.

reentry.steps.step14.en: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
reentry.steps.step14.draft: Ka rubuta ranar da za a yi shari'a da kuma lokacin da za a shiga kotu

reentry.steps.step17.en: Check your fines, fees and restitution
reentry.steps.step17.draft: Bincika takardunku, kudade da kuma kudaden da kuka biya

reentry.steps.step19.en: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
reentry.steps.step19.draft: Shiga cikin Medicaid, da kuma SNAP idan kana bukatar shi

reentry.steps.step7.en: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
reentry.steps.step7.draft: Nemo wurin zama mai aminci (kira 211 ko albarkatun gida na gida)

reentry.steps.step8.en: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
reentry.steps.step8.draft: Nemo abinci don wannan mako (kira 211 ko kantin abinci na gida)
